'''Death Star Destruction''' was a type of energy drink. It was described as flavorful.

==Description==
The Death Star Destruction came in a can, which featured an X-wing prominently as a decal, as well as the name of the Energy Drink in Aurebesh.

==History==
It was sold by a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] officer, next to a statue of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] in [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet]] on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] during [[Empire Day/Legends|Empire Day]] in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]].

==Etymology==
The name of the energy drink was an obvious reference to the events of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], which entailed the destruction of the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first]] [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]].

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:DeathStarDestructionLabel.png|250px|thumb|Death Star Destruction energy drink label]]
Death Star Destruction energy drinks were featured in the [[Wikipedia:MMORPG|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'' during Empire Day, a live player event that began on [[June 24]] [[2008]], to celebrate the fifth anniversary of ''Galaxies''. They were available for purchase by Rebel-aligned player characters and gave players a temporary experience bonus and a speed boost. They were brought back in [[2009]] for the sixth year anniversary of ''Galaxies'', this time with a decor version of the item. The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] equivalent for the event were [[Order 66 Cookie]]s. However, some versions of the event do have an Imperial Organizer supplying the energy drink despite its Rebel ties for 5 Empire Tokens.
